description: Hawaiian cooking centers on ginger, rice, and coconut. Tropical acid, coconut, and fusion of island and Asian influences.

attributes.micro_lesson: Pineapple and lime acid, coconut milk richness, grill for smoke.
attributes.shopping_tip: Coconut milk, rice, macadamia, and fresh tropical fruit.
flavor_building: Start with coconut as your cooking medium.
Season with ginger — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around rice as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Hawaiian food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
Ask Clara for dish matches from our 280k+ recipe corpus filtered to this cuisine.
